description: Opens the site's start page like an ad click in a fresh browser once per consent choice: no choice and on to the next page, accept all, reject all and analytics only. Returns which tags sent after each choice, and a matrix of the first Google hit's consent, whether the campaign parameters reached it, whether the GA4 client id was kept, the _gcl_aw cookie, the cookies set, when each tag was called and the Google tag's own consent, with what should not happen marked. Needs a consent banner the tool can answer. Takes about half a minute per choice.

allowed_hosts.description: Other hosts the pages may load from or redirect to.

campaign.description: The campaign parameters to open the start page with, as the UTM check. Default true: test values (utm_source=aitd, gclid=aitd-gclid, fbclid=aitd-fbclid...) unless the site address already carries campaign parameters. false opens the site as given. Or your own values, e.g. {"utm_source": "newsletter", "utm_campaign": "autumn", "gclid": "test123"}; allowed keys: gclid, wbraid, gbraid, fbclid, ttclid, msclkid, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content.

concurrency.description: How many choices to try at once, each in its own browser. Default 2.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default en.

providers.description: Tracking providers to count. Default ga4, google_ads, meta, tiktok plus any other known platform the site sends to.

site.description: The page to start from, e.g. https://www.example.com/

name: consent_matrix
title: Compare every consent choice side by side
